label: Detection learns hotspot
caption:
GT: 1.0 cm shallow | Pred: 1.00 cm shallow
CAM locks onto a focal high-response hotspot.
Matches contrast + peak-intensity descriptors.

label: Size learns contour
caption:
GT: 1.75 cm deep | Pred: 1.75 cm deep
CAM follows the footprint/contour rather than one pixel.
Matches morphology + late-contrast descriptors.

label: Depth uses diffusion
caption:
GT: deep | Pred: deep
Depth CAM emphasizes broader spread and position.
Consistent with weak radius/spread descriptors.

label: Detection error: heterogeneity
caption:
GT: negative window | Pred: P>gate, 1.25 cm
Detected hotspot differs from the planted 1.75 cm group.
Likely solid/bronchus-like heterogeneity; cross-check can exclude.

label: Size error: deformation
caption:
GT: 1.25 cm | Pred: 1.49 -> 1.5 cm
CAM expands over a broad deformed footprint.
Adjacent-bin error is deformation-consistent.

label: Depth error: weak separability
caption:
GT: 0.5 cm deep | Pred: 0.51 cm middle
Detection and size remain correct, but depth CAM is shifted.
Suggests weak spread cue and contact/sliding ambiguity.
